summary.text: Frank Sossamon is the Republican candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Bryan Cohn. A pastor, he represented the district from January 2023 to January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Frank Sossamon was born in North Carolina and is a Pentecostal pastor; his career has included serving as senior pastor of South Henderson Pentecostal Holiness Church and founding the chaplain program at Maria Parham Hospital.

He was also president and a board member of the Henderson/Vance County Crime Stoppers, the Vance County Juvenile Crime Prevention Council, the Granville County Crime Stoppers and the North Carolina Crime Stoppers Association.
Sossamon defeated incumbent Democrat Terry Garrison in the 2022 general election for District 32, 51.3 percent to 48.7 percent.
In the 2023-2024 session he served on the Appropriations, Appropriations on Education, Commerce, Education - K-12 and Transportation committees.
He lost the 2024 general election to Bryan Cohn, 48.4 percent to 48.9 percent.
In 2026 he advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, and Cohn was selected in June as the Democratic nominee after Curtis McRae withdrew.
